طُورٌ : see طَوْرٌ, latter part, in two places. ―
-b2- The yard (فِنَآء) of house; (K;) as also ↓ طُوَرَةٌ . (TA.) [See also طَوَار, voce طَوْرٌ, last signification.] ＝
-A2- A mountain: (S, O, K:) or any mountain that produces trees, otherwise a mountain is not so called. (R, TA.) [Hence الطُّورُ is applied to Mount Sinai, which is also called طُورُ سِينَآءَ, and طُورُ سِينِينَ; and to the Mount of Olives, and to several other mountains; as is said in the K &c.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
